methodology: Acute Food Insecurity projections by FEWS NET based on ongoing monitoring of the factors that influence food security – staple food prices, household income, rainfall, crop production, conflict, etc.
name: malawi-acute-food-insecurity-classification-october-2015-march-2016
notes: Current (October 2015) food security outcomes and forward-looking analysis representing the most likely food security outcomes for the near term (October 2015 - December 2015) and medium term (January 2016 - March 2016) periods.

organization.name: fewsnet
organization.title: FEWS NET
organization.description:
FEWS NET, the Famine Early Warning Systems Network, is a leading provider of early warning and analysis on acute food insecurity around the world.

FEWS NET continues to resume their programming following a brief pause in operations in early 2025. HDX is collaborating with FEWS NET to restore data from their data warehouse as soon as possible.
